children: First Tracks Biotherapeutics reported a net loss of $31.4M for the third quarter of 2026, compared with a $41.9M loss a year earlier, while diluted loss per share narrowed to $0.88 from $1.5. The company also reported progress across its ANB033 and rosnilimab programs.
Net loss was $31.4M, compared with $41.9M in the prior-year quarter; the loss narrowed 25.1% year over year.
Diluted loss per share was $0.88, compared with $1.50 in the prior-year quarter; the loss narrowed 41.3% year over year.

Phase 1b gluten-challenge data for ANB033 in celiac disease showed significant improvements in gut histology and symptoms versus placebo, with no serious or severe adverse events. A second celiac cohort is assessing mucosal healing without a gluten challenge.

The company plans Phase 2 trials of ANB033 in vitiligo and another indication, and a global Phase 1b trial in eosinophilic esophagitis to assess safety, swallowing symptoms and esophageal inflammation.
Phase 2b rheumatoid arthritis results for rosnilimab showed improvements across disease measures, with responses deepening through six months and persisting after treatment ended.
The healthy-volunteer Phase 1 trial of ANB101, initiated in March 2025, was completed in August 2026.
